census_notes.confirmation: every census site was confirmed as a real e8 call in objdump output disassembled from its containing FDE start (0x5d8bd5c inside 0x5d8bd30, 0x5e4bfca inside 0x5e4bea0, 0x5e4c2d5 inside 0x5e4c1a0); the two larger callers' internals were not read, so only their call sites are claimed
census_notes.method: per-byte scan of the .text file bytes for e8/e9 opcodes, decoding the rel32 target in objdump virtual-address space (.text file offset = VA - 0x1000), plus a whole-file qword search for the target VA and a .rela.dyn parse for R_X86_64_RELATIVE slots whose addend is the target

consumer_caller.scan_argument: object + 0x8f0 with a null query, so the scan counts every node of that list
consumer_caller.summary: when the byte at object + 0x978 is zero it returns the field at object + 0x948 at once; otherwise it takes the scan result when it is nonzero and below field948, then takes the smaller of that candidate and the + 0xc38 value of the record at object + 0x8e8, with a zero value leaving the candidate in place

min_update.rule: the running minimum starts at 0; a callee result of 0 is skipped entirely, so a later nonzero result still replaces it; a nonzero result replaces the running value exactly when it is below it (lea -1(%r12) then unsigned cmovae); the result is therefore the minimum over the nonzero callee results, or 0 when there is none

scan_behavior.empty_outer_list: the first node's pointer equals the sentinel, so the window returns 0 at once
scan_behavior.matched_nodes: a matched node advances the outer list with no call and no update
scan_behavior.null_query: the query pointer is null, so every node takes the call path
scan_behavior.unmatched_nodes: each unmatched node calls 0x5f0a1d0 with the node's key record and feeds its + 0xc38 value into the minimum

match_rules.hash_bucket_index: the node's key value divided (unsigned div) by the bucket count at query + 0x08; the remainder is the bucket index; a zero bucket count faults on div (no guard)
match_rules.hash_chain: the bucket array base is at query + 0x00; a null slot means no match; the first entry's key is compared directly with no bucket check; every later entry's key must hash to the same bucket or the search ends as no match; a null next pointer ends as no match
match_rules.hash_link_test: on a hit the window tests (%r9): nonzero advances as matched, zero falls to the call path; in every traced hit that field holds the matching entry itself, so the zero arm is not reachable from the traced paths and is recorded as an open unknown
match_rules.linear_chain: the chain head is at query + 0x10; entries link via + 0x00 and carry the compared key at + 0x08; a match is an entry whose + 0x08 field equals the node's key record; a null head or an exhausted chain means no match
match_rules.mode_select: query + 0x18 == 0 selects the linear chain; nonzero selects the hash buckets

object_layout.node: next pointer at node + 0x00, key-record pointer at node + 0x10
object_layout.outer_list_header: object + 0x08 (the walk ends when the next pointer equals the header itself)
object_layout.query: bucket array pointer at query + 0x00, bucket count at query + 0x08, linear chain head at query + 0x10, mode flag at query + 0x18

unknowns: the owning component and the meaning of the outer list, the query record and the + 0xc38 field are not pinned; only their layout and the scan arithmetic are claimed
whether the zero arm of the 0x5f13571 link test is reachable by any input the traced paths cannot produce; it is recorded literally and the model treats a null link as no match
the internals of the two larger callers (0x5e4bea0, 0x5e4c1a0) and of the query's producers; only their call sites are claimed

value_callee.summary: returns the qword at its argument + 0xc38; the scan always passes the node's key record, so the scanned value is that record's + 0xc38 field
